blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Generating editable graphic designs requires arranging visual and textual elements into a coherent composition while preserving their content and editability. Although recent MLLM-based approaches employ iterative generation and visual refinement to reflect the real-world design workflows, their high-level plans are predetermined prior to execution, limiting their adaptability as the design evolves. To address this limitation, we propose PlayGround, a progressive layout generation framework that dynamically adapts to the current rendered canvas. PlayGround establishes a progressive design loop comprising a Progressive Planner, a Layout Generator, and a Visual Verifier, guided by a Structure-Aware Retriever. Given an initial set of unordered elements, the Structure-Aware Retriever initially infers a coarse layout structure to retrieve structurally similar reference designs. Subsequently, at each turn, the Progressive Planner examines the current rendered canvas alongside the remaining elements, forms the next functional group, and plans its composition. The Layout Generator then predicts editable layout attributes, while the Visual Verifier evaluates rendered candidates and provides feedback when refinement is necessary. To train the Progressive Planner with step-wise supervision, we construct a two-stage data generation pipeline that extracts functional groups and turn-level planning trajectories from completed designs. Experiments on Crello and LICA demonstrate the effectiveness of PlayGround over existing methods. Our code and weights will be publicly released.
blocks.zh: 生成可编辑的图形设计需要将视觉元素和文字元素排列成一个连贯的构成,同时保留其内容和可编辑性. 虽然最近基于MLLM的方法采用迭代生成和视觉改进来反映现实世界的设计工作流程,但其高层次的计划在执行前是预先确定的,随着设计的发展限制了它们的适应性. 为了解决这个限制,我们提议PlayGround,一个渐进的布局生成框架,能动态地适应当前制成的画布. PlayGround 建立了一个渐进式设计环,包括一个渐进式规划器,一个布局生成器,和一个视觉验证器,由结构-智能检索器指导. 由于初始的一组无序元素,结构-Aware Retriever最初推断出粗糙的布局结构来取回结构上相近的参考设计. 随后,进步规划员在每一回合都与其余要素一起审查目前形成的情况,组成下一个职能小组,并规划其组成。 然后布局生成器预测出可编辑的布局属性,而视觉验证器则评审出候选人,并在需要改进时提供反馈. 为了对进步规划师进行分步监督的培训,我们建造了一个两阶段的数据生成管道,从已完成的设计中抽取功能组和回合级的规划轨迹。 Crello和LICA的实验演示了PlayGround在现有方法之上的有效性. 我们的代码和重量将公开发布。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Graphic design is a key medium for effectively communicating visual and textual information across domains such as advertising, e-commerce, and presentation authoring, yet its production requires substantial time and expertise.
To automate this process, AI-based approaches have been extensively studied along two main directions.
One directly synthesizes the final design as a pixel-level image using diffusion-based generative models ( Li et al., 2023 ; Gao et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) , while the other predicts layouts of given image and text elements to produce an editable document ( Inoue et al., 2023 ; Inoue et al., 2024 ) .
Although text-to-image generative models achieve high visual quality, they still struggle with accurate text rendering and faithful preservation of input elements, and their raster outputs limit element-level editing.
In contrast, layout generation models represent designs in structured formats such as JSON or HTML/CSS, supporting content fidelity and editability.
blocks.zh:
图形设计是将视觉和文字信息有效传播到广告、电子商务和演示文稿编写等领域的关键媒介,但其制作需要大量时间和专门知识。
为了实现这一进程的自动化,围绕两个主要方向广泛研究了基于AI的方法。
一个直接将最终设计合成为像素级图像,使用以扩散为基础的基因模型(Li等,2023;Gao等,2025;Wang等,2025;而另一个则预测给定图像和文字元素的布局,以产生可编辑的文件(Inoue等,2023;Inoue等,2024).
尽管文本到图像的基因模型实现了高视觉质量,但它们仍然与准确的文本渲染和忠实地保存输入元素相抗衡,其光栅输出限制了元素级别的编辑.
相形之下,布局生成模型代表JSON或HTML/CSS等结构化格式的设计,支持内容忠实和可编辑性.

blocks.en:
Recently, Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have been adopted for editable layout generation due to their strong multimodal understanding and reasoning capabilities.
While pioneering works ( Cheng et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2025 ; Patnaik et al., 2025 ) exploited MLLMs to directly predict layout attributes such as position, size, and ordering from multimodal elements (Fig. 1 (a)), recent works aim to reflect the iterative nature of real-world design workflows.
PosterCopilot ( Wei et al., 2026 ) enabled iterative editing and rearrangement of generated designs, while VFLM ( Guo et al., 2026 ) progressively refines text layouts using visual feedback from rendered results.
Other works introduced an explicit planning stage into the design workflow.
DesignAsCode ( Liu et al., 2026 ) combines semantic planning, HTML/CSS generation, and visual refinement, while PSDesigner ( Shuai et al., 2026 ) integrates element collection and grouping with sequential placement and refinement.
Although these works have successfully enhanced the overall design quality, their workflows rely heavily on initial planning and element grouping decisions that cannot be revised using intermediate visual feedback (Fig. 1 (b)).
blocks.zh:
最近,由于多式联运的理解和推理能力很强,采用了多式大型语言模型(MLLMs)进行可编辑布局生成。
虽然开创性作品(成等,2025;林等,2025;帕特纳克等,2025)利用了MLLMs直接预测布局属性,如位置,大小和从多模式元素订购(图1 (a)),但近期作品旨在反映现实世界设计工作流程的迭接性.
海报驾驶员 (Wei等人,2026年)允许对生成的设计进行迭代编辑和重排,而VFLM(Guo等人,2026年)则利用所生成结果的视觉反馈来逐步完善文本布局.
其他作品在设计工作流程中引入了明确的规划阶段.
DesignAsCode(Liu等,2026年)结合了语义规划,HTML/CSS生成,并进行视觉改进,而PSDesigner(Shuai等,2026年)则结合了元素收集和分组,并进行相继的放置和完善.
虽然这些作品成功地提高了总体设计质量,但其工作流程严重依赖初步规划和要素分组决定,这些决定无法使用中间视觉反馈进行修改(图1(b))。

PlayGround在检索到的参考资料上附加条件,然后通过一个进步规划员、一个布局生成器和一个视觉验证员的迭接工作流程来完成设计。

blocks.en:
To enable dynamic planning, the Progressive Planner observes the current canvas and the remaining elements at each turn and determines which elements to place together.
However, leaving the Planner to form arbitrary groups provides no clear criterion for deciding which elements should be grouped, potentially leading to ambiguous grouping decisions.
We therefore predefine the unit of each turn as a functional group, a set of elements that share the same role ( e.g., background, title) in the design, and train the Planner to identify such groups.
Consequently, at each turn, the Progressive Planner selects a functional group and plans its composition in the context of the current canvas.
blocks.zh:
为了能够进行动态规划,进步规划师观察当前布局和每个转弯的剩余要素,并决定将哪些要素放在一起。
然而,让规划员组成任意团体并没有为决定哪些要素应归为一组提供明确的标准,这可能导致分组决定不明确。
因此,我们预先确定每个转弯的单位为一个功能组,一组在设计中具有相同作用(如背景,标题)的元素,并训练规划师识别出这些组.
因此,在每一回合,进步规划师都会选择一个职能小组,并结合当前情况规划其组成。

blocks.en:
Subsequently, the Layout Generator realizes the plan by predicting the layout attributes of the elements in the group, and the Visual Verifier inspects the rendered result, returning feedback for the Layout Generator to revise its predictions when necessary.
The accepted canvas is then passed back to the Planner, so that later grouping and planning decisions adapt to the actual partial design rather than to an assumed one.
By decomposing the design process into a progressive procedure, our experimental results validate that PlayGround produces high-quality and consistent final designs.
blocks.zh:
随后,布局生成器通过预测组内元素的布局属性实现计划,而可视验证器检查得到的结果,为布局生成器回馈反馈,以在必要时修改预测.
随后被接受的画布被转回"规划师",使后期的分组和规划决定适应实际的部分设计而不是假设的设计.
通过将设计过程分解成渐进程序,我们的实验结果验证了PlayGround生产出高质量和一致的最终设计.

blocks.en:
Such progressive planning, however, requires step-wise supervision which does not exist in conventional layout datasets.
Therefore, we additionally develop a two-stage data construction pipeline, which decomposes the layout designs into functional groups and generates supervision for group-wise turn-level planning.
Together with the original layout attributes, these annotations supervise the Structure-Aware Retriever, Progressive Planner, and Layout Generator.
blocks.zh:
然而,这种渐进式规划需要逐步监督,这在传统的布局数据集中并不存在。
因此,我们进一步开发出两相数据建设管线,将布局设计分解为功能组,并产生对分组转向层规划的监督.
这些说明与原始布局属性一起,监督结构-智能检索器、进步规划器和布局生成器。

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose PlayGround , a progressive layout generation framework that integrates dynamic planning and functional grouping to reflect the real-world design workflow. • We introduce a Progressive Planner that decomposes the complex design process into sequential steps and progressively plans each step based on the current rendered canvas. • We define functional groups as the planning unit, providing a principled grouping criterion by organizing elements that share the same role in the design. • We develop a two-stage data construction pipeline that derives group-wise, turn-level supervision from completed designs. • Experiments on Crello and LICA demonstrate improved design quality and zero-shot generalization, with ablations validating the effectiveness of our key components.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Graphic design composition methods either arrange supplied visual and textual elements ( Inoue et al., 2023 ; Lin et al., 2025 ) or additionally generate and retrieve elements during the design process ( Jia et al., 2024 ; Inoue et al., 2024 ) ; our work focuses on the former task. Moving beyond direct composition, iterative graphic design systems incorporate visual feedback to refine generated results. PosterCopilot ( Wei et al., 2026 ) combines layout reasoning with layer-controllable iterative editing, while VFLM ( Guo et al., 2026 ) progressively refines text layouts through a generation–rendering–reflection–refinement cycle. DesignAsCode ( Liu et al., 2026 ) constructs a semantic plan, implements it as HTML/CSS, and subsequently refines the rendered design, while PSDesigner ( Shuai et al., 2026 ) combines element collection and planning with sequential placement and refinement. Despite these iterative mechanisms, their initial planning or grouping decisions remain fixed throughout generation. In contrast, PlayGround dynamically updates both decisions at each turn based on the current rendered canvas. Additional related works are discussed in Appendix A .

DesignAsCode(Liu等,2026年)构建了语义计划,作为HTML/CSS执行,并随后完善了已提供的设计;而PSDesigner(Shuai等,2026年)则将元素收集和规划与相继放置和完善结合起来. 尽管有这些迭接机制,其初步规划或分组决定在一代人中仍然固定不变。 相比之下,PlayGround根据当前渲染的画布,在每一个转弯时动态地更新两个决定. 附录A讨论了其他相关工作。

blocks.en:
To construct turn-level annotations for functional grouping and layout planning required by PlayGround , we build a two-stage data construction pipeline on Crello ( Yamaguchi, 2021 ) dataset using GPT-5.6 Luna ( OpenAI, 2026 ) as an MLLM annotator.
For each design, we use the title from the Crello metadata and the intention annotation provided by OpenCOLE ( Inoue et al., 2024 ) as additional semantic context, together with the complete element inventory and rendered design.
blocks.zh:
为了构建PlayGround所要求的功能分组和布局规划的回合级说明,我们用GPT-5.6 Luna(OpenAI,2026年)作为MLLM注释器在Crello(山口,2021年)数据集上建造了两相数据构建管道.
对于每项设计,我们使用Crello元数据的标题和OpenCOLE(Inoue等,2024年)提供的意向注释作为附加语义上下文,加上完整的元素盘点和渲染设计.

blocks.en:
We first decompose each design into functional groups and determine their execution order, as illustrated in Fig. 2 (left).
A functional group is a set of elements that jointly serve a common design function and are intended to be planned and positioned together.
Each group is categorized into one of six roles: background , visual/hero , title/headline , content , support , or decorative .
A group may contain image elements, text elements, or both, and multiple groups may share the same role when they should be planned and placed independently.
Finally, groups that provide visual references for other groups are placed earlier in the execution order to serve as visual anchors.

每个组分为六个角色之一:背景、视觉/英雄、标题/标题、内容、支持或装饰。
一个组可能包含图像元素,文本元素,或者两者兼而有之,多个组在应当独立规划和放置时可能共享相同的作用.
最后,为其他团体提供视觉参考的团体被放在更早的执行命令中担任视觉主播.

blocks.en: 4.1 Problem Formulation and Overview
blocks.zh: 4.1 问题的提出和概述

blocks.en: Given a set of image and text elements, our goal is to arrange them into an editable graphic design. Following LaDeCo ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , we predict the bounding box and text-specific attributes of each element, while additionally predicting the stacking order within each functional group.
blocks.zh: 考虑到一组图像和文本元素,我们的目标是将它们安排成一个可编辑的图形设计. 在LaDeCo(Lin等,2025年)之后,我们预测每个元素的边框和文本特性,同时另外预测每个功能组内的堆放顺序.

blocks.en:
Figure 3 illustrates the workflow of PlayGround .
Initially, the Structure-Aware Retriever (Sec. 4.2 ) predicts a coarse layout structure and retrieves five structurally similar references as global composition priors.
Then, at each turn, the Progressive Planner (Sec. 4.3 ) observes the current canvas, i.e., the canvas accepted from the preceding turn, together with the remaining elements, and forms a functional group and its layout plan. Conditioned on this plan, the Layout Generator (Sec. 4.4 ) predicts the layout attributes of the elements in the group and generates multiple candidate layouts.
Lastly, the Visual Verifier (Sec. 4.5 ) selects the best candidate by evaluating their rendered results and either accepts it or provides feedback to the Layout Generator for regeneration.
Once accepted, the selected canvas becomes the current canvas for the next turn, and the placed elements are removed from the remaining element set. This continues until all elements are placed.

最初,结构-Aware Retriever(Sec. 4.2)预测出粗糙的布局结构并检索到5个结构相近的参考文献作为全球构成前作.
然后,进步计划员(Sec 4.3)在每个回合观察目前的画布,即上个回合接受的画布,连同所余要素,组成一个功能组及其布局计划. 基于此计划,布局生成器(Sec 4.4)预测了组中元素的布局属性并生成多个候选布局.
最后,视觉验证员(第4.5条)通过评价结果选择最佳候选人,或者接受结果,或者向布局生成器提供反馈供再生。
一旦被接受,所选的画布会成为下个转弯的当前画布,所放置的元素会被从所剩的元素集中去掉. 这一直持续到所有元素都到位为止。

However, predicting precise bounding boxes for all elements at this stage would negate the benefits of progressive generation by effectively predicting the entire layout upfront.

blocks.en:
We initialize our Retriever, Planner, and Layout Generator with Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025 ) and fine-tune them using LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) , while GPT-5.6 Luna ( OpenAI, 2026 ) is used as the Visual Verifier.

blocks.en: We evaluate on the Crello-v4 ( Yamaguchi, 2021 ) and LICA ( Hirsch et al., 2026 ) datasets, training all learnable components on Crello and evaluating LICA in a zero-shot setting. We compare PlayGround against open-source graphic design composition baselines, including FlexDM ( Inoue et al., 2023 ) , LaDeCo ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , PosterCopilot ( Wei et al., 2026 ) , and VFLM ( Guo et al., 2026 ) , in the setting of arranging given visual and textual elements into a final design. Detailed settings of baselines are provided in Appendix D.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们评价了Crello-v4(山口,2021年)和LICA(Hirsch等,2026年)数据集,在Crello上培训了所有可学习的组件,并在零镜头设定下评价了LICA. 我们比较PlayGround与开源图形设计构成基线,包括FlexDM(Inoue等,2023年),LaDeCo(Lin等,2025年),PosterCopilot (Wei等,2026年),和VFLM(Guo等,2026年),在将给定的视觉和文字元素安排入最终设计时的设置. 基准的详细设置载于附录D.1。

blocks.en: Following prior works ( Jia et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2025 ; Hong et al., 2026 ; Wei et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) , we evaluate both perceptual design quality and structural validity. We use GPT-5 ( OpenAI, 2025 ) as a VLM judge to independently score six criteria from 1 to 5: (i) layout composition rationality, (ii) typography legibility and hierarchy, (iii) visible element presentation, (iv) color harmony and contrast, (v) visual style coherence, and (vi) design intention alignment. We additionally report two rule-based metrics, text occlusion (T.Occ.) and text unreadability (Rea.), which measure text covered by foreground elements and background complexity beneath text, respectively. Further evaluation details and a complementary user study are provided in Appendix D.2 .
blocks.zh: 继前作(贾等作,2024;林等作,2025;洪等作,2026;魏等作,2026;刘等作,2026)后,我们评价了知觉设计质量和结构有效性. 我们使用GPT-5(OpenAI,2025年)作为VLM评分,从1到5独立评分6个标准: (一)布局成分合理性, (二)打字可辨性和分级性, (三)可见元素呈现, (四)色彩和谐与对比, (五)视觉风格一致性, (六)设计意图一致. 我们还要报告两个基于规则的衡量标准,即文本封存(T.Occ.)和文本不可读性(Rea.),这两个衡量标准分别由文本下面的前景要素和背景复杂性所涵盖。 附录D.2提供了进一步评价详情和补充用户研究报告。

blocks.en: 5.2 Comparison with State-of-the-Art Methods
blocks.zh: 5.2 与最新方法的比较

blocks.en:
Table 1 shows that PlayGround leads the baselines on all six VLM metrics on Crello and five of six on LICA, indicating strong overall graphic design quality.
Its performance on LICA without additional fine-tuning further supports strong zero-shot generalization.
The low standard deviations also indicate consistent design quality.
We attribute this consistency in part to our Progressive Planner, which forms each plan from the actual canvas state, aligning composition decisions with the evolving design.
While VFLM also exhibits lower variation on some metrics, we attribute this behavior to its constrained setting of rendering only text on a fixed ground-truth background.
For the rule-based metrics, PlayGround achieves lower T.Occ. and Rea. than FlexDM, LaDeCo, and PosterCopilot, indicating fewer text occlusions and less complex backgrounds beneath text.
Note that VFLM’s lower T.Occ. is an expected artifact of its text-only rendering constraint.

它在LICA上的性能没有额外的微调,进一步支持了强烈的零射通化.

虽然VFLM在一些度量标准上也表现出了较低的差异,但我们将这种行为归结于它仅限于在固定的地上真实背景上渲染文字的受限设定.

请注意,VFLM下游的T.Occ.是其仅用文本渲染约束的预期文物。

blocks.en: Figure 4 compares the rendered designs of each method with the corresponding ground truth. PlayGround consistently produces coherent image–text compositions by capturing spatial and semantic relationships among input elements. It places text in appropriate free regions without obscuring salient visuals and effectively uses supporting elements to strengthen typography, as shown in the second and fourth examples. Compared with VFLM, which places text on a ground-truth visual background, PlayGround achieves competitive or better typography and hierarchy while jointly composing visual and textual elements. The third to fifth examples further show that PlayGround can produce plausible alternatives to the ground truth with strong balance and hierarchy. In contrast, several baselines exhibit fragmented compositions, out-of-canvas placement, or undesirable occlusions. These results highlight the benefit of PlayGround , which composes related elements as functional groups and adapts placement and stacking decisions to the evolving canvas.
blocks.zh: 图4将每种方法的渲染设计与相应的地真相比较. PlayGround通过捕捉输入元素之间的空间和语义关系,不断生成一致的图像-文本组成. 它将文本放在适当的自由区域,而不模糊突出的视觉,并有效利用辅助元素来强化打字功能,如第二和第四例所示. 与将文本放入地上真实视觉背景的VFLM相比,PlayGround在联合编组视觉和文字元素的同时,实现了竞争性或更好的打字和分级. 第三至第五个例子进一步表明,PlayGround可以产生具有强烈平衡和分级的地面真理的可信替代品。 与此相反,若干基线显示的成分零散、放置在空地之外或不可取的隔离。 这些结果凸显出PlayGround 的好处,它将相关元素组成了功能组,并适应了不断演变的画布的布置和堆放决定.

More importantly, (III), which uses the lowest-ranked references under our metric, performs even worse than using no references, indicating that mismatched references can harm generation and supporting the effectiveness of our metric in retrieving structurally similar designs.

We next examine candidate generation and verification. Comparing (I), (IV), and (V), performance consistently improves as the number of candidates K K increases, showing the benefit of generating multiple layout candidates. Comparing (I) and (VI), removing the visual verifier and randomly selecting a candidate causes a clear drop, demonstrating the importance of evaluating rendered candidates, selecting the best one, and providing feedback for regeneration.
Finally, (VII) uses a separately trained Qwen3-VL-based ( Bai et al., 2025 ) Static Planner that generates the entire plan once at the beginning. Its lower performance than (I) demonstrates the benefit of progressive planning from intermediate renders rather than relying on a fixed initial plan. Fig. 5 further illustrates this difference: our Planner uses the available upper-left space for text, whereas the static plan targets a central placard region already occupied by photographs. Further ablation settings are in Appendix D.3 .

blocks.en: We study per-turn granularity and grouping using GPT-5.6 Luna in a zero-shot setting with only the Planner–Layout Generator loop to isolate these factors. We compare (I) element-wise generation, (II) full-layout generation that places all elements at once, (III) LaDeCo-style semantic-layer grouping, and (IV) our functional grouping.
blocks.zh: 我们用 GPT-5.6 Luna 在零镜头设定下研究每个回合的颗粒度, 我们比较(一)元素的生成,(二)将所有元素同时放入的全放出生成,(三)LaDeCo风格的语义层组,(四)我们的功能组.

blocks.en:
Without grouping, (I) element-wise generation outperforms (II) full-layout generation, suggesting that decomposing layout generation into sequential decisions is beneficial. However, both group-based variants (III, IV) further improve performance, showing that jointly planning and placing functionally related elements provides a more effective unit for iterative composition.
Compared with (III) LaDeCo-style grouping ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , which uses five predefined semantic layers and a fixed placement order, PlayGround forms groups from six functional roles without fixing the number of groups. The higher VLM score of (IV) supports the benefit of this more flexible grouping strategy for our iterative generation pipeline.

相较于(III)LaDeCo-tyle编组(Lin等,2025年),该编组使用5个预定义的语义层和固定的布置顺序,PlayGround编组从6个功能角色中分出而未确定组数. 较高的VLM分数(IV)支持这种更灵活的组合战略对我们的迭代生成管道的好处.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We propose PlayGround , a progressive layout generation framework that adapts composition decisions to the evolving rendered canvas. At each turn, the Progressive Planner forms a functional group from the remaining elements and plans its composition based on the current canvas. A Structure-Aware Retriever provides global composition guidance by predicting a coarse layout structure and retrieving structurally similar references. To enable such progressive planning, we further introduce a two-stage data construction pipeline that constructs functional groups and derives supervision for group-wise turn-level planning from completed designs. Experiments on Crello and LICA demonstrate improved design quality and zero-shot generalization over existing composition methods, while ablations validate the effectiveness of our key components.
blocks.zh: 我们提议PlayGround(PlayGround),一个渐进式的布局生成框架,使组成决定适应不断变化的布局。 进步规划师在每一回合都从其余要素中组成一个职能小组,并根据目前的布局规划其组成。 A Structure-Aware Retriever通过预测粗糙的布局结构并检索结构上相近的引用,提供全局构成指导. 为了能够进行这种渐进式规划,我们进一步引入了两阶段数据建设管道,该管道将功能组组成起来,并从已完成的设计中获得对集团的回合级规划的监督。 Crello和LICA的实验显示,设计质量有所提高,对现有组成方法进行了零镜头概括,同时模拟验证了我们关键部件的有效性。

blocks.en:
MLLMs have rapidly advanced in visual perception, language understanding, and reasoning, enabling their application to a wide range of multimodal tasks ( Bai et al., 2025 ; OpenAI, 2024 ; OpenAI, 2025 ; OpenAI, 2026 ) .
Recently, their use has expanded beyond standalone task models to multi-stage systems in which multiple MLLMs collaborate within a unified pipeline ( Yao et al., 2025 ) .
In graphic design and layout generation, MLLMs are also increasingly used for data generation ( Guo et al., 2026 ) and evaluating generated outputs ( Deganutti et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
MLLMs在视觉感知,语言理解和推理方面迅速进步,使得它们能够被应用于广泛的多模式任务(Bai等,2025;OpenAI,2024;OpenAI,2025;OpenAI,2026).
最近,它们的使用已经从单独的任务模式扩大到多个阶段的系统,其中多个MLLMs在一个统一的管道内进行协作(Yao等人,2025年)。
在图形设计和布局生成中,MLLMs也越来越多地被用于数据生成(Guo等,2026年)和评价所生成的输出(Deganutti等,2026年).

blocks.en: Beyond the iterative graphic design systems discussed in Sec. 2 , we review two broader lines of work: (1) content-aware layout generation and (2) graphic design composition.
blocks.zh: 除了 Sec. 2所讨论到的迭代图形设计系统之外,我们回顾两条更广泛的工作线:(1) 内容感知布局生成和(2) 图形设计构成。

blocks.en: Content-aware layout generation. Content-aware layout generation arranges predefined elements such as text, logos, and underlays on a given background canvas ( Hsu et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Hsu and Peng, 2025 ) . Building on this setting, PosterLlama ( Seol et al., 2024 ) and PosterLLaVA ( Yang et al., 2024 ) leverage LLMs and MLLMs to support more flexible layout conditions. Retrieval-augmented approaches, such as RALF ( Horita et al., 2024 ) and LayoutCoT ( Shi et al., 2026 ) , retrieve reference layouts using background information or available layout constraints. In these settings, the background content or layout conditions provide spatial cues for plausible element placement. In contrast, our setting starts from a blank canvas and requires determining the positions and scales of all supplied elements without such observable spatial cues. We therefore infer coarse layout structure from the input elements themselves and retrieve structurally similar references.
blocks.zh: 内容意识布局生成. 内容意识布局生成在给定的背景画布上安排了文字,标志等预先定义的元素和底板(Hsu等,2023;张等,2024;Hsu和彭等,2025. 在此设定的基础上,PosterLlama(Seol等,2024年)和PosterLLAVA(Yang等,2024年)利用LLM和MLLM支持更灵活的布局条件. RALF(Horita等,2024年)和布局CoT(Shi等,2026年)等检索强化方法,利用背景资料或现有布局限制检索参考布局. 在这些环境下,背景内容或布局条件为可能元素的位置提供了空间提示. 相比之下,我们的设定是从空白的画布开始的,要求在没有这种可观察到的空间提示的情况下确定所有提供元素的位置和尺度。 因此,我们从输入元素本身推断出粗糙的布局结构,并检索结构相似的参考文献。

blocks.en:
Graphic design composition. Another line of work composes complete editable documents from multimodal elements.
FlexDM ( Inoue et al., 2023 ) , Graphist ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) , LaDeCo ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , and AesthetiQ ( Patnaik et al., 2025 ) predict structured layouts for supplied visual and textual elements.
Other works, including COLE ( Jia et al., 2024 ) , OpenCOLE ( Inoue et al., 2024 ) , CreatiPoster ( Hong et al., 2026 ) , and IGD ( Qu et al., 2025 ) , additionally generate or retrieve visual elements as part of the design process.
Our work specifically focuses on composing a fixed inventory of supplied elements, without generating or retrieving additional elements.
While effective at generating editable documents, existing graphic design composition methods do not fully capture the iterative workflow of real-world design, as they provide limited support for revising composition decisions based on visual feedback from rendered results.
blocks.zh:
图形设计组成. 另一行工作是从多式联运要素中完成可编辑的文件。
FlexDM (Inoue等人, 2023年),制图学家 (Cheng等,2025年),"LaDeCo"(Lin等,2025年)和"爱思端克". (Patnaik等,2025年)预测所提供的视觉和文字元素的结构布局.
其他著作,包括COLE(Jia等,2024年),OpenCOLE (Inoue等人,2024年),CreatiPoster。 (Hong等,2026),和IGD(Qu等,2025),作为设计过程的一部分,额外生成或取回可视元素.
我们的工作特别侧重于对供应的元素进行固定的清点,而不产生或检索额外的元素。
现有的平面设计构成方法虽然能有效生成可编辑的文件,但并不能完全抓住现实世界设计的迭接工作流程,因为它们为根据从结果中获得的视觉反馈修订组成决定提供了有限的支持.

blocks.en: Appendix B Data Construction Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 数据构建细节

blocks.en: B.1 Definition of Functional Group Roles
blocks.zh: B.1 职能小组作用的定义

blocks.en: We define a closed set of six functional roles to characterize the semantic and compositional functions of each group. As described in Sec. 3 , elements are first grouped according to their compositional relationships, and a role is then assigned to each resulting group according to the definitions below.
blocks.zh: 我们定义了一套封闭的由6个功能作用构成的功能,以描述每个组的语义和组成功能. 如第3节所描述的,元素首先根据其构成关系进行分组,然后按照以下定义将一个角色分配给每个由此产生的组.

blocks.en: A background group establishes the canvas-wide base layer of a design and remains behind the main foreground content. Its defining characteristics are broad canvas coverage, placement beneath the main content in the stacking order, and a primarily foundational rather than independently semantic role. A background may consist of a single element or multiple adjacent, tiled, split, or overlapping elements that together form a continuous backdrop. Plain solid-color fields or visually indistinguishable elements are included when they satisfy these criteria, whereas foreground panels, cards, overlays, or independently meaningful visual elements are excluded even if they occupy a large portion of the canvas. When no supplied element or combination of elements forms such a base layer, the canvas itself is treated as the implicit background.
blocks.zh: 一个背景小组建立设计时的全画布底层,并保留在主前景内容后. 其定义性特征是广布覆盖,在堆放顺序中置于主要内容下方,并主要具有基础性而非独立的语义作用. 一个背景可能由一个单一的元素或多个相邻的,平板的,分出或相重叠的元素组成,这些元素共同构成连续的背景. 普通的固体-色彩字段或可视化的元素在满足这些标准时被包含在内,而前景面板,卡片,上盖,或独立有意义的视觉元素即使占据了画布的一大部分,也被排除在外. 当未提供元素或元素组合形成这样的基层时,画布本身被视作隐含的背景.

blocks.en:
A visual/hero serves as a semantic visual object or anchor in the composition, regardless of whether it is the primary or a secondary focal element.
Its defining characteristic is that it carries meaningful visual content rather than functioning purely as background or decoration.
Typical examples include photographs, products, people, scenes, illustrations, diagrams, and message-bearing visual containers such as signs, badges, placards, quote cards, emblems, and typographic-poster frames.
When such a visual also contains independently planned title/headline , content , support , or decorative elements, those elements remain in their own functional groups rather than being absorbed into the visual/hero .
Multiple components are treated as a single visual/hero only when they function as one inseparable visual object rather than as independently editable semantic layers.
blocks.zh:
视觉/英雄在组成中充当语义视觉物体或锚地,无论它是主要还是次要的焦点元素.
它的决定性特征是,它带有有意义的视觉内容,而不是纯粹作为背景或装饰发挥作用。
典型的例子有相片,产品,人,场景,插图,图案等,以及带有信件的视觉容器,如道具,徽章,花牌,引文卡,徽章等,并有打字机-招贴画相框等.
当这种视觉还包含独立规划的标题/标题、内容、支持或装饰元素时,这些元素仍属于自己的功能组,而不是被被视觉/英雄所吸收。
多个组件只有在它们作为一个不可分割的视觉物体发挥作用时,而不是作为可独立编辑的语义层时,才会作为单一的视觉/英雄处理.

blocks.en:
A title/headline is an attention-leading typographic unit that establishes a distinct semantic and visual anchor in the design.
It typically includes titles, headlines, slogans, taglines, or tightly coupled subtitles, including those placed within a visual/hero container.
Small visual elements such as underlines, highlights, ornaments, or simple backings are included in the same group when they are structurally attached to and primarily serve the headline.
Text whose main purpose is informational, functional, or supportive rather than attention-leading is assigned to another role.
blocks.zh:
标题/标题是注意力引领的打字单位,在设计中建立鲜明的语义和视觉主播.
它通常包括标题、头条、口号、标记线,或紧接的字幕,包括放在视觉/英雄容器内的字幕。
在结构上附着并主要服务于头条时,小的视觉元素如下划线,亮点,饰物,或简单的后背被包含在同一组.
其主要目的是提供信息、功能或支持而不是引导注意力的文本被分配到另一个角色。

blocks.en:
A content group conveys information whose primary purpose is to be read or understood.
It includes body text, supporting copy, quotes, captions, descriptions, dates, times, venues, schedules, factual information, and non-promotional pricing.
Text belongs to content when it neither functions as the dominant headline nor primarily serves branding, contact, action, or other utility purposes.
blocks.zh:
内容组传递信息,其主要目的是被读取或理解.
它包括正文、佐证副本、引文、标题、说明、日期、时间、地点、时间表、事实资料和不促进定价。
文本既不作为主导标题,也不主要为品牌、接触、行动或其他用途服务,则属于内容。

blocks.en:
A support group provides identity, action, attribution, or other functional information that supports delivery of the main message.
Typical examples include logos, brand identifiers, sponsor marks, websites, contact information, social handles, addresses, QR codes, calls-to-action, buttons, promotional offers, discounts, legal notices, credits, and footer material.
Its defining characteristic is functional utility rather than visual prominence, so a support group may still occupy a visually salient position in the composition.
blocks.zh:
一个支持组提供身份,动作,归属,或其他功能信息,支持主要消息的传递.
典型的例子有:徽标,品牌标识,赞助人标记,网站,联系信息,社会手柄,地址,QR代码,呼叫到行动,按钮,促销报价,折扣,法律通告,信用,和脚印等.
它的决定性特征是功能效用而不是视觉显要,因此一个支助小组在组成中可能仍然占据视觉显要位置.

blocks.en:
A decorative group provides non-semantic visual embellishment that contributes to the overall composition without primarily carrying content, identity, or action.
It includes independently composed ornaments, accent systems, atmospheric overlays, and standalone decorative motifs that span the design or have no clear semantic host.
Decorative elements that specifically support another functional group—such as a border, divider, frame, highlight, accent shape, pattern, or ornamental icon attached to a title/headline , visual/hero , content , or support —are instead included in that group.
Multiple ornaments that jointly form one coherent decorative system are grouped together rather than treated as separate decorative groups.
blocks.zh:
装饰组提供非语义视觉装饰,有助于整体构成,而不会主要携带内容,身份或动作.
它包括独立编织的饰品,口音系统,大气覆盖,以及跨越设计或没有清晰语义宿主的独立装饰齿轮.
具体支持另一个功能组的装饰性元素——例如,标题/标题所附带的边框、分隔器、框架、突出音、口音形状、图案或装饰图标、视觉/英雄、内容或支持——则被归入该组。
联合形成一个连贯的装饰体系的多处装饰被归为一组,而不是作为单独的装饰组别对待.

blocks.en: B.2 Detailed Data Construction Pipeline
blocks.zh: B.2 详细数据建设管道

blocks.en:
Fig. 6 provides a detailed example of our two-stage data construction pipeline.
In Stage 1, the input elements are organized into functional groups with their roles and execution order.
In Stage 2, each execution-ordered group is converted into a turn-level plan containing the grouping, execution, and layout rationales together with a layout instruction.
The resulting sequence provides group-wise supervision for progressively constructing the complete design.
blocks.zh:
图6提供了我们两阶段数据建设管道的详细实例。
在第一阶段,输入要素按其作用和执行顺序分为功能组。
在阶段2中,每个被执行命令的组被转换成一个回合级计划,包含分组,执行,布局原理以及布局指令.
由此产生的序列为逐步构建完整的设计提供了分组监督.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Detailed Data Construction Pipeline. Stage 1 constructs functional groups and their execution order, and Stage 2 derives a turn-level plan for each group.
blocks.zh: 图6:详细数据构建管道. 第1阶段构建功能组及其执行顺序,第2阶段为每个组制定回合级计划.

blocks.en: B.3 Group and Execution Statistics
blocks.zh: B.3 团体和执行统计

blocks.en: We analyze the functional groups and execution orders constructed by our annotation pipeline to characterize the supervision used for group-wise layout generation. As shown in Fig. 7(a) , designs are typically decomposed into multiple functional groups, with four to six groups accounting for the majority of the data. Fig. 7(b) further shows that all six predefined functional roles are represented, with no single role dominating the resulting groups. Together, these statistics show that the constructed supervision decomposes complete layouts into multiple functionally diverse group-level decisions rather than treating all elements as a single prediction target.
blocks.zh: 我们分析我们的注解管道构建的功能组和执行命令,以描述用于分组布局生成的监管特征. 如图7(a)所示,设计通常被分解成多个功能组,其中四至六组占大多数数据. 图7(b)进一步显示,所有六个预先界定的职能角色都有代表,没有单一的角色主宰由此产生的群体。 这些统计合在一起表明,所构建的监理将完整的布局分解成多个功能多样的群级决策,而不是将所有元素作为单一的预测目标来对待.

blocks.en: (a) Number of functional groups per design.
blocks.zh: (a) 每项设计的职能组数目。

blocks.en: (b) Distribution of functional group roles.
blocks.zh: (b) 职能小组角色的分配。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Statistics of the constructed functional groups.
blocks.zh: 图7:已建功能组的统计。

blocks.en: The constructed groups also vary substantially in their internal composition. As shown in Fig. 8(a) , the average number of elements per group differs across functional roles: background and visual/hero groups are typically compact, whereas decorative, title/headline, and content groups tend to contain more elements.
blocks.zh: 建筑组的内部组成也大相径庭。 如图8(a)所示,每个组的平均要素数量因职能角色而异:背景和视觉/英雄组一般是紧凑的,而装饰性、标题/标题和内容组往往包含更多的要素。

blocks.en: Fig. 8(b) further shows that our grouping is not constrained by modality. While background, visual/hero, and decorative groups are almost exclusively image-only, substantial portions of title/headline (38.9%), content (34.4%), and support (42.6%) groups contain both text and image elements. This indicates that functionally associated text and visual elements can form a common compositional unit and be planned together.
blocks.zh: 图8(b)进一步表明,我们的分类不受方式的限制。 虽然背景、视觉/英雄和装饰团体几乎完全是图像,但相当一部分标题/标题(38.9%)、内容(34.4%)和支持(42.6%)团体都包含文字和图像要素。 这表明功能相联的文本和视觉元素可以形成一个共同的构成单位并一起规划.

blocks.en: (a) Mean group size by functional role.
blocks.zh: (a) 按职能作用分列的平均群体规模。

blocks.en: (b) Modality composition by functional role.
blocks.zh: (b) 按职能组成的模式。

blocks.en: Figure 8: Group size and modality composition by functional role.
blocks.zh: 图 8:按职能角色划分的组规模和模式构成.

blocks.en: The execution annotations also exhibit a clear role-dependent structure. As shown in Fig. 9 , background groups are overwhelmingly placed at the beginning of the trajectory, and visual/hero groups are concentrated in early turns. In contrast, content and support groups are distributed more heavily toward the middle and later stages, while decorative groups span a broader range of turns. These patterns indicate that the annotated execution order is closely associated with the functional role of each group, yielding structured construction trajectories in which foundational visual components are generally established before subsequent content and supporting elements.
blocks.zh: 执行说明还显示出一个明确的角色依赖结构. 如图9所示,背景小组绝大多数位于轨迹起步处,视觉/英雄小组集中在早期。 与此相反,内容和支持小组在中后阶段的分布更为广泛,而装饰小组则跨出范围更广的轮回. 这些模式表明附加说明的执行命令与每个组的功能作用密切相关,产生结构化的构造轨迹,其中基础视觉组件一般在后续内容和辅助元素之前被确立.

blocks.en: Figure 9: Execution-turn distribution by functional role. Each row shows the distribution of execution turns for the corresponding functional role. T1, T2, … \ldots denote the first, second, … \ldots group-wise planning turns, and T10+ denotes turn 10 or later.
blocks.zh: 图9:按职能作用分列的执行周期分布情况。 每行显示执行回合对相应功能角色的分布. T1, T2, ... \ ldots 表示第一, 二, .\ ldots 分组规划转弯, T10+ 表示转弯 10 或后转.

groups. Separate a visual or structural anchor from content that can be planned

with that block; create a separate decorative block only for

that stage and, when applicable, which rendered anchor it depends on or
establishes for later groups. assigning roles. Multiple groups may share the same non-background role only
when they form genuinely separate local compositions with independent anchors
or execution dependencies. [STRICT OUTPUT CONTRACT] Return exactly one valid JSON object with top-level keys
groups and execution_order. Each group contains:
group_id, role, elements, and
grouping_reason. Each execution-order entry contains:
group_id and execution_reason. Across all groups, elements must form an exact partition of the
supplied element IDs, and every valid group_id must appear exactly
once in execution_order. [… additional JSON-format validation and output example omitted …]

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 PlayGround Inference

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 summarizes the complete inference procedure of PlayGround . The Structure-Aware Retriever first retrieves five reference designs, which remain fixed throughout generation. At each turn, the Planner forms the next functional group and its plan from the current canvas and remaining elements, after which the Layout Generator produces K K candidate layouts for the selected group. The Visual Verifier then either accepts the best rendered candidate or revises the layout instruction for regeneration, for up to R max = 3 R_{\max}=3 rounds. The accepted canvas and updated remaining elements define the next state, and this process repeats until all input elements are placed.
blocks.zh: 算法1总结了PlayGround的完整推论程序. 结构-Aware Retriever首先检索了5个参考设计,这些设计在一代人中始终固定不变. 每个回合,规划师都会从目前的画布和所剩元素组成下一组功能组及其计划,之后布局生成出K K 所选组的候选布局. 然后,视觉验证器要么接受最佳的候选,要么修改再生的布局指令,最多为R max = 3 R max = 3发. 被接受的画布和被更新的剩余元素定义了下一个状态,这个过程重复到所有输入元素被放置为止.

Fig. 10 visualizes a complete generation trajectory of PlayGround .
The retrieved references are fixed before generation, and each turn shows the selected functional group and layout instruction, the K K candidate layouts produced by the Layout Generator, the Visual Verifier decision, and the resulting updated canvas.
As generation progresses from turn 1 to turn 5, the accepted canvas is repeatedly carried forward as the visual state for the next planning turn.

被检索的引用在生成前是固定的,每个转弯显示选定的功能组和布局指令,由布局生成器制作的 K K 候选布局,视觉验证器决定,以及由此而来的最新布局.

blocks.en:
The example also illustrates the feedback loop within a turn.
At turn 4, the verifier rejects the initially selected candidate because the newly placed text overlaps the existing robot and crowds the lower-right composition.
It therefore revises the layout instruction and regenerates the same group; the second-round candidate is then accepted after placing the text in a clearer region.
This example highlights how progressive planning and turn-level verification jointly construct the design while adapting to the evolving canvas.

blocks.en: C.2.2 Retriever Behavior Analysis

blocks.en:
We analyze how often individual references are reused across test queries to examine whether retrieval collapses to a small set of frequently selected designs.
For each reference appearing in the Top-5 retrieval results, we count the number of test queries for which it is selected.
As shown in Fig. 11 , most references are selected for only one or a few queries, and the number of references decreases rapidly as the selection frequency increases.
This indicates that the Retriever produces diverse reference choices across queries rather than repeatedly relying on a small set of references.

blocks.en: D.1 Evaluation Setup
blocks.zh: D.1 评价设置

blocks.en:
We adapt each baseline to its native input formulation while keeping the
underlying Crello elements consistent whenever possible.
FlexDM, LaDeCo, and PlayGround receive the original image and text elements as
separate editable inputs.
PosterCopilot represents all elements as images; therefore, we first render each
text element using its ground-truth text attributes and provide the resulting
text renders as image elements together with the original visual elements.
VFLM is specialized for text placement on a fixed background, so we render all
ground-truth non-text elements to construct the background canvas and provide
only the text elements for layout prediction.
These settings follow the input assumptions of each method while using the
same source design content.

我们调整每个基线,使其适应本土投入的配方,同时保持

Poster Copilot作为图像代表所有元素;因此,我们首先渲染每个元素
文本元素,使用其地面真实文本属性,并提供由此产生的
文本与原始视觉元素一起制作成图像元素。
VFLM是专门用来在固定的背景上放置文本的,所以我们让所有
用于构建背景图并提供
只有用于布局预测的文本元素。
这些设置遵循了每种方法的输入假设,同时使用
相同的源设计内容.

blocks.en: LICA ( Hirsch et al., 2026 ) does not provide document titles, which are required as metadata inputs to our pipeline. We therefore generate a title for each LICA sample using Qwen3.5-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) . We use the ground-truth rendered image together with the available LICA metadata, including the description, aesthetics, tags, and user intent, to generate a short document title. The generated title is used only as auxiliary metadata during LICA inference.

blocks.en:
Our quantitative evaluation uses both VLM-based and rule-based metrics.
The VLM-based metrics assess perceptual design quality and alignment with the
design intention from completed renders, while the rule-based metrics measure
structural and spatial properties of the generated layouts.

设计意图完成后即成,而基于规则的衡量尺度

blocks.en: D.2.1 VLM-based Metrics
blocks.zh: D.2.1 以VLM为基础的计量

blocks.en:
We use GPT-5 ( OpenAI, 2025 ) ( gpt-5-2025-08-07 ) as the VLM judge.
For each design, the judge receives the final rendered image and the
corresponding design intention, without access to source elements,
ground-truth layouts, intermediate renders, or method identity.
For Crello-v4, we use the intention annotations provided by
OpenCOLE ( Inoue et al., 2024 ) , while LICA uses
its original user_intent annotations.
The judge independently assigns an integer score from 1 to 5 to each of the six
criteria using the fixed evaluation prompt and structured output format.

blocks.en: Each criterion defines anchors for integer scores from 1 to 5, and the judge scores the six criteria independently. Criteria (i) through (v) focus on the perceptual quality of the visible design, while criterion (vi) additionally evaluates consistency with the provided design intention. We define the six evaluation criteria as follows:
blocks.zh: 每个标准都定义了从1到5的整数分数的主锚,评委对这6个标准进行独立分数. 标准 (一)至 (五) 注重可见设计的概念质量,而标准 (六) 进一步评价与所提供的设计意图的一致性。 我们界定六项评价标准如下:

blocks.en: • (i) Layout composition rationality covers balance, alignment, grouping, spacing, whitespace, visual flow, and density at the level of the full design. Overlap and alignment enter this score only when they affect the visible composition. • (ii) Typography legibility and hierarchy covers readability at the presented scale, typographic choices, contrast between text and the background, spacing, line breaks, reading order, hierarchy, clipping, overlap, and broken glyphs. It does not check exact wording or spelling. • (iii) Visible element presentation covers framing, cropping, scale, clarity, visibility, and compositing of non-text imagery, graphics, icons, shapes, and decorations. It does not assess the artistic merit of an element or its fidelity to an unseen source. • (iv) Color harmony and contrast covers palette relationships, color balance, and separation between foreground and background. If insufficient contrast makes text difficult to read, the resulting loss of legibility is counted under typography and is not counted again here. • (v) Visual style coherence checks whether typography, imagery, decorations, backgrounds, and effects form a consistent visual language. It excludes color harmony, thematic relevance, originality, and personal preference. • (vi) Design intention alignment compares the intention with evidence visible in the render. It assesses whether the design realizes the stated purpose, message, format, and salient content or style cues, while excluding source preservation, requirements that cannot be observed in the render, similarity to the ground truth, general visual polish, and character-level text transcription.

blocks.en: (i) Layout composition rationality covers balance, alignment, grouping, spacing, whitespace, visual flow, and density at the level of the full design. Overlap and alignment enter this score only when they affect the visible composition.
blocks.zh: (一)布局结构合理性涵盖均衡,对接,组合,间隔,白相间,视觉流,和全设计水平的密度. 重叠和对齐只有在影响可见成分时才会输入此分数.

blocks.en: (ii) Typography legibility and hierarchy covers readability at the presented scale, typographic choices, contrast between text and the background, spacing, line breaks, reading order, hierarchy, clipping, overlap, and broken glyphs. It does not check exact wording or spelling.
blocks.zh: (二)打字可辨别性和分级性,涵盖所呈现的分级可读性,打字选择,文本与背景的对比,间距,分行,读取顺序,分级,剪接,重叠,和断裂的格子. 它不检查确切的措辞或拼写。

blocks.en: (iii) Visible element presentation covers framing, cropping, scale, clarity, visibility, and compositing of non-text imagery, graphics, icons, shapes, and decorations. It does not assess the artistic merit of an element or its fidelity to an unseen source.
blocks.zh: (三)可见元素的呈现涵盖非文字图像,图形,图标,外形和装饰等的布局,裁剪,尺度,清晰度,能见度等. 它不评估某一要素的艺术价值,也不评估其对一个看不见的来源的忠诚。

blocks.en: (iv) Color harmony and contrast covers palette relationships, color balance, and separation between foreground and background. If insufficient contrast makes text difficult to read, the resulting loss of legibility is counted under typography and is not counted again here.
blocks.zh: (四)相色相和对比覆盖调色板关系,相色相平衡,并分出前地和后地. 如果对比不足使文本难以被读取,由此产生的可辨读性损失在打字法下计算,在此不再计算.

blocks.en: (v) Visual style coherence checks whether typography, imagery, decorations, backgrounds, and effects form a consistent visual language. It excludes color harmony, thematic relevance, originality, and personal preference.
blocks.zh: (五)视觉风格一致性检查打字,图像,装饰,背景,效果是否形成一致的视觉语言. 它排除了色彩和谐,主题相关性,原创性,以及个人偏好.

blocks.en: (vi) Design intention alignment compares the intention with evidence visible in the render. It assesses whether the design realizes the stated purpose, message, format, and salient content or style cues, while excluding source preservation, requirements that cannot be observed in the render, similarity to the ground truth, general visual polish, and character-level text transcription.
blocks.zh: (六) 设计意向校正,将意向与提交中可见的证据进行比较。 它评估设计是否实现了所宣称的目的,消息,格式,以及显著的内容或风格提示,同时排除了源保存,渲染中无法被遵守的要求,与地面真实性相似,一般视觉光泽,以及字符级的文字抄写.

blocks.en:
Prompt Used for VLM Evaluation You are a rigorous evaluator of completed poster and graphic-layout renders. Evaluate the final render using the six criteria below. For criteria 1--5,
judge the image as if the design intention were unavailable. Do not reward,
penalize, or reinterpret visible execution based on whether it matches the
intention. Use the design intention only for
design_intention_alignment. Score the six criteria independently with integers from 1 to 5, using only
their criterion-specific anchors. Do not let one overall impression determine
every score. Count the same visible defect under multiple criteria only when it
causes a distinct failure under each criterion’s definition. General rules: - Judge at the presented viewing scale. Do not assume content becomes legible
or clean when zoomed in. - Do not penalize deliberate whitespace, overlap, asymmetry, cropping, or
stylistic contrast unless it visibly harms function or coherence. - Do not equate visual complexity, decoration, or realism with quality. - Score every criterion. Never return null, N/A, not_evaluable, or an omitted
field. SCORING CRITERIA 1. layout_composition_rationality Evaluate macro-level spatial organization: balance, alignment, grouping,
spacing, whitespace, distribution of visual weight, regional flow, and density
or crowding. Do not score text legibility, color harmony, style coherence, or
pixel-level artifacts here. Judge overlap and alignment by their visible
compositional impact, not as raw counts. - 5: Spatial organization is deliberate and balanced, with clear grouping and
flow and no meaningful awkward gap or crowding. - 4: Organization is sound, with only minor local imbalance, spacing,
alignment, or grouping issues. - 3: The layout remains functional, but noticeable imbalance, awkward gaps,
weak grouping, or crowding requires revision. - 2: Major imbalance, fragmentation, or crowding disrupts navigation and
substantially weakens the layout. - 1: Spatial organization is chaotic or effectively absent, with no usable
grouping or flow. 2. typography_legibility_and_hierarchy Evaluate visible typography as a communication system: legibility at the
presented scale, apparent font size and choice, text-background contrast, line
breaking, letter and line spacing, reading order, hierarchy, clipping, overlap,
and visibly broken or blurred glyphs. Judge apparent typographic execution, not
exact wording or spelling. - 5: All visually important text is readily legible, and typographic levels
create an immediate, effective reading order. - 4: Text and hierarchy are clear overall, with only minor issues in secondary
text, spacing, contrast, or emphasis. - 3: The main text remains usable, but noticeable legibility, line-break,
spacing, contrast, or hierarchy issues require revision. - 2: Important visible text is difficult to read or the typographic hierarchy
is substantially confusing. - 1: The visible text system is functionally unusable, or no functional visible
typography is present. 3. visible_element_presentation Evaluate the visible presentation of non-text imagery, graphics,
illustrations, icons, shapes, and decorations: framing, harmful crop,
off-canvas placement, relative scale, distortion, blur or pixelation,
occlusion, focal-subject visibility, collisions, seams, halos, transparency,
and compositing integration. Judge visible presentation and integration, not
subject matter or intrinsic artistic merit. Text-specific defects belong to
typography_legibility_and_hierarchy. - 5: Visible non-text elements are cleanly framed, identifiable, appropriately
scaled, and integrated, with no meaningful presentation or compositing problem. - 4: Element presentation is strong, with only minor localized framing, scale,
clarity, or integration issues. - 3: Most visible elements remain usable, but noticeable crop, occlusion,
distortion, collision, clarity, or integration problems require revision. - 2: Major presentation problems substantially obstruct or weaken one or more
visually prominent elements. - 1: Prominent visual elements are severely cropped, obscured, distorted,
degraded, off-canvas, or colliding to the point of functional failure. 4. color_harmony_and_contrast Evaluate the visible color system: palette harmony, hue, saturation and
brightness relationships, foreground-background separation, distribution and
balance of color, and unwanted clashes. Judge color as an internally
functioning system, not theme appropriateness or personal taste. When contrast
specifically makes text hard to read, score that functional consequence under
typography_legibility_and_hierarchy rather than duplicating the penalty here. - 5: The palette is harmonious and controlled, with effective visual
separation and no meaningful clash or imbalance. - 4: Color relationships are strong, with only minor localized imbalance,
dullness, excess intensity, or weak separation. - 3: The palette remains usable, but noticeable clashes, muddy relationships,
uneven distribution, or weak contrast require revision. - 2: Major color conflicts or contrast failures substantially weaken visual
organization and coherence. - 1: The color system is severely dysfunctional, with pervasive clashes,
muddiness, or loss of visual separation. 5. visual_style_coherence Evaluate whether the visible typeface personality, imagery treatment,
illustration or icon language, decorations, background, and effects form a
deliberate, mutually consistent visual system. Judge cross-element consistency
and integration, not personal taste, theme appropriateness, originality, color
harmony itself, or the intrinsic beauty of individual assets. - 5: All visible treatments form a polished, coherent visual language with no
meaningful stylistic conflict. - 4: The visual language is strong, with only minor localized inconsistency or
unresolved styling. - 3: Styling is workable, but noticeable conflicts or inconsistencies make the
design feel partly unresolved. - 2: Major treatment conflicts substantially weaken stylistic coherence. - 1: The design lacks a usable visual language or contains severe stylistic
conflicts that make it feel visibly broken. 6. design_intention_alignment Evaluate how well the final render visibly realizes the supplied design
intention: its main purpose or topic, intended message, format or use, and
salient explicit theme, mood, style, or content cues. Judge alignment jointly
from the intention and visible render. Do not assess source-asset preservation,
unseen requirements, exact ground-truth similarity, general visual polish, or
character-perfect text transcription here. - 5: The main purpose and message are immediately recognizable; all salient
explicit cues are visibly fulfilled with no meaningful contradiction. - 4: The intention is clearly realized and most salient cues are fulfilled,
with only a minor omission or weakness. - 3: The broad topic or purpose is recognizable, but important cues are only
partially realized or remain ambiguous. - 2: The render has only a limited connection to the intention; major cues are
absent or contradicted and the intended message is hard to recover. - 1: The render is unrelated to or strongly contradicts the intention; the
intended purpose is not recognizable. For each criterion, provide one integer score and one English evidence sentence
of no more than 30 words. State only the most decisive evidence; do not restate
the criterion, anchor, or score. For criteria 1--5, evidence must cite only visible image properties and must not
mention or rely on the design intention. For criterion 6, evidence must connect
a salient intention cue to its visible fulfillment or failure. Return only the schema-constrained result. Do not provide a total, average,
overall score, failure tag, or additional commentary. {FINAL_RENDER_IMAGE} DESIGN INTENTION — USE ONLY FOR CRITERION 6 {DESIGN_INTENTION}

blocks.en: D.2.3 User Study
blocks.zh: D.2.3 用户研究

blocks.en: Figure 14: User Study Results. Human ranking distributions across six evaluation criteria.
blocks.zh: 图14:用户研究结果。 人类排名分布于6个评价标准.

blocks.en: We conducted a user study comparing PlayGround against four baselines: FlexDM ( Inoue et al., 2023 ) , LaDeCo ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , PosterCopilot ( Wei et al., 2026 ) , and VFLM ( Guo et al., 2026 ) . The study involved 32 participants and 25 randomly selected samples from the Crello-v4 test split. For each evaluated sample, participants ranked the five methods’ outputs from 1 (best) to 5 (worst) independently for each criterion. We used the six criteria defined for our VLM-based evaluation in Sec. D.2.1 : (i) layout composition rationality, (ii) typography legibility and hierarchy, (iii) visible element presentation, (iv) color harmony and contrast, (v) visual style coherence, and (vi) design intention alignment.
blocks.zh: 我们进行了一项用户研究,将PlayGround与四个基线进行比较:FlexDM (Inoue等,2023年). LaDeCo (Lin等,2025年). Poster Copilot (Wei等,2026年),和VFLM(郭等,2026年). 该研究涉及32名参与者和25个随机选取的从Crello-v4测试分出样本. 对于每个经评价的样本,参与者将每种方法的产出从1个(最佳)到5个(最坏)进行独立排序。 我们使用了我们基于VLM的评价在Sec.D.2.1中界定的六项标准:(一)布局成分合理性,(二)打字可辨性和分级性,(三)可见元素呈现,(四)色彩和谐与对比,(五)视觉风格相通,(六)设计意图相通.

blocks.en: The user study results are presented in Fig. 14 . PlayGround ranks first in approximately 81–84% of responses and among the top two in approximately 95–97% across all six criteria. Notably, PlayGround jointly arranges both visual and textual elements yet outperforms VFLM, which places only text on a fixed ground-truth background. We attribute this advantage in part to progressive planning from the current rendered canvas, which allows text placement to adapt to available space and previously placed elements. The human evaluation results are also consistent with the VLM-based results reported in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 用户的研究结果在Fig中介绍. 14. PlayGround在大约81-84%的答复中名列前茅,在所有六项标准中名列前2名。 值得注意的是,PlayGround联合安排了视觉和文字两个要素,但效果却超过了VFLM,它只将文本放在固定的地上真实背景上. 我们将这一优势部分归因于从目前制成的画布上逐步进行规划,这使得文字放置能够适应现有的空间和以前放置的元素. 人类评价结果也与表1所汇报的基于VLM的结果一致。

blocks.zh: 附录F 有意到设计任务的扩展

blocks.en:
Our main setting assumes that the visual and textual elements to be composed are
provided in advance. In practice, however, users may specify only a design
intention without having the corresponding elements. To examine whether PlayGround can
operate in this setting, we extend it to intention-to-design generation, where
the required elements are first generated from the intention and then composed
into a final editable design.
blocks.zh:
我们的主要设定假设,将构成的视觉和文字要素是:

意图没有相应的要素。 检查 PlayGround 是否可以
在此情况下,我们把它扩展至意图到设计生成。
所需要素首先由意图产生,然后构成
输入最终可编辑设计。

blocks.en:
To do so, we prepend an element-generation stage to PlayGround . Given a design
intention, GPT-5.6 Luna ( OpenAI, 2026 ) first derives the required textual
elements and descriptions of the visual elements. Qwen-Image-2.1 ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) then generates the corresponding visual elements from these descriptions. The resulting
visual and textual elements are then provided directly to PlayGround , which performs
its standard functional grouping and progressive layout generation without
modifying the core composition pipeline.
